subject: The Circle season 8 fan voting
query: how to vote on the circle hulu
title: How do you vote on The Circle on Hulu? Season 8 fan voting explained
answer: You vote on The Circle season 8 through the show's TikTok account, @TheCircleHulu, or by text message. Voting windows open live on Thursdays, and the results shape the next week's episodes. You can cast up to 10 votes per window. The new season premieres on Hulu on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.
body:
Audience voting is the biggest change since The Circle moved from Netflix, which aired seven seasons from 2020 to 2024, to Hulu. It is the first time viewers of the U.S. version can influence the game while it is still being played. According to Parade, the first vote opened on Nov. 11, before the premiere, and asked fans to choose a contestant to enter the game. ABC7 reported that an early vote lets fans pick whether the duo of Layla Taylor and Kate Racker plays as a catfish persona named Doug or one named Steven. Viewers can also vote for a fan-favorite player, who wins $10,000.

Release schedule: the season has 16 episodes released over five weeks. The premiere is Tuesday, Nov. 17, at 9 p.m. ET (6 p.m. PT), and new episodes drop on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. The finale is Friday, Dec. 18, 2026. Episodes stream on Hulu, and bundle subscribers can also watch through Hulu on Disney+.

What else is new: content creator and author Tinx (Christina Najjar) replaces Michelle Buteau as host, and celebrities play alongside regular contestants. ABC7 named former Bachelorette Hannah Brown and dancer Sasha Farber, who play as themselves, and chef Dominic "Chef Dom" DeAngelis, who is catfishing as Lisa Vanderpump. The game is filmed in real time in an Atlanta apartment building, the same one used for seasons 6 and 7. Players still never meet face to face and talk only through the Circle app. The highest-rated player after the final ratings wins $100,000.
in_the_news: The Circle returns on Hulu on Nov. 17, 2026, with live fan voting for the first time, and viewers are asking how to take part.

faq.q: Is The Circle season 8 on Netflix?
faq.a: No. Season 8 is a Hulu series. Seasons 1 through 7 remain Netflix shows.

faq.q: What time does The Circle come out on Hulu?
faq.a: The premiere is set for 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on Tuesday, Nov. 17, 2026.

faq.q: How many episodes are in The Circle season 8?
faq.a: 16 episodes over five weeks, with the finale on Dec. 18, 2026.

faq.q: Who is the host of The Circle on Hulu?
faq.a: Tinx, whose real name is Christina Najjar. She replaces Michelle Buteau, who hosted the Netflix seasons.

faq.q: How much does the winner of The Circle get?
faq.a: $100,000 for the winner. A fan-favorite player chosen by viewer votes gets $10,000.

faq.q: How many times can I vote on The Circle?
faq.a: Up to 10 votes per voting window, on TikTok or by text, according to Parade.
